items.title: Being a closed immersion is fpqc local on the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the property 'f is a closed immersion' is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6184-6188). The proof reduces the two constituents separately: closed immersions are affine, so descent of affineness makes f affine; it then remains to show that O_Y -> f_* O_X is surjective, and this is checked stalkwise: for a point y the covering supplies i and y_i over y, flat base change identifies f_{i,*}(O_{Y_i x_Y X}) with the pullback of f_* O_X, the assumption makes it a quotient of O_{Y_i}, and surjectivity of the map after tensoring up to the faithfully flat local ring O_{Y_i,y_i} forces surjectivity at y (proof lines 6190-6216). The level is H3: the reduction to stalks and the use of faithful flatness of the local ring extension is a genuine local computation, displayed in full.
